_meta.description: Home brings together the academic profile, research interests, publications, selected research projects and background.

en.heroIntro: Rongqi Lu holds an M.Eng. in Control Engineering from Xidian University. His research focuses on multi-robot coordination and multi-agent reinforcement learning, particularly efficient communication, cooperative decision-making, and autonomous exploration in complex environments.
en.beyondResearch: Beyond research, his interests include LLM applications, workflow automation, and homelab infrastructure. He has developed and maintains several open-source projects, including reinforcement learning baselines, productivity tools, and LaTeX templates for academic writing. He is also interested in macroeconomics, asset allocation, and crypto assets, and practices index investing.

rows: Optimal Control, Multi-agent Systems, Embedded Systems

zh.heroIntro: 陆荣琦，西安电子科技大学控制工程硕士。研究方向为多机器人协同与多智能体强化学习，关注复杂环境下的高效通信、协同决策与自主探索。
zh.beyondResearch: 研究之外，关注大模型应用、工作流自动化与家庭网络架构，开发并维护多个开源项目，涵盖强化学习基线实现、效率工具和 LaTeX 模板；同时研究宏观经济、资产配置与加密货币，践行指数化投资。
